preconditions.description: The number of notes n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 200000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each note position a_i must be between 1 and 200,000.
The length of the notes list must match the number of notes n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any_convenient_fingering else True
postconditions.description: If no convenient fingering exists, output -1.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= 5 for b_i in b)
postconditions.description: Each finger number b_i must be between 1 and 5.

postconditions.expression: all((a[i] < a[i+1] and b[i] < b[i+1]) or (a[i] > a[i+1] and b[i] > b[i+1]) or (a[i] == a[i+1] and b[i] != b[i+1]) for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The fingering must satisfy the convenience conditions for all adjacent notes.
